reselling_model.strategy: Managed Static Site Hosting for SMBs
reselling_model.target_customer: Small businesses needing landing pages + blogs without WordPress complexity
reselling_model.value_prop: Deploy + custom domain + SSL + CDN + form integration + analytics setup
reselling_model.scale_constraint: Free tier is generous for static sites; main limit is bandwidth (100GB/mo). Heavy media sites may exceed.
reselling_model.tos_compliance_note: Render permits commercial usage on free tier. Managed hosting services are allowed. No partner program required.

risks: Bandwidth limit (100GB/mo) shared across all sites on free account; heavy traffic clients may exceed
No preview environments on free tier; client approval workflow requires manual staging
Build times may be slower on free tier during peak hours; no priority queue
Custom domains require DNS configuration per client; no bulk provisioning API
No native form handling; requires external service (Formspree, Netlify Forms alternative)
next_steps: Build site provisioning script via Render API
Create automated deploy pipeline for client repos (GitHub/GitLab integration)
Design form handling integration with free-tier compatible services
Test bandwidth monitoring and alerting for multi-client accounts
Draft migration playbook from free to Pro for growing clients
